ScenarioDef.Name: Rimconemy_SandboxScenario
ScenarioDef.label: Rimconemy Sandbox
ScenarioDef.description: A Rimconemy survival run with sandbox policy: the colony never auto-ends on wipe. Use this scenario when you want to freely roam with no game-over pressure. Mod 02's progression system still runs; the only difference is the GameOver trigger.

scenario.summary: Rimconemy survival sandbox with the standard player faction and surface layer.
